## ℹ️ About Us

**Rock Insurance Company** is a leading provider of personal and commercial insurance solutions, serving millions of customers nationwide through our independent agents, direct channels, and specialized home insurance products.

- **Founded:** 1978
- **Headquarters:** Columbus, Ohio
- **Employees:** 12,000+
- **Total Written Premium (YTD):** $2,393.5M

### Our Mission
> _"To protect what matters most — with integrity, innovation, and heart."_

### Core Values
- 🤝 **Integrity** — We do the right thing, always
- 💡 **Innovation** — We embrace change and technology
- 🌍 **Community** — We invest in the people we serve
- 📈 **Excellence** — We hold ourselves to the highest standards

---

## 💼 Business Groups

### 1. Independent Agent Group
Distributes personal and commercial lines through a national network of independent agents.
- **GWP (YTD):** $1,435.0M | **Net Income:** $139.0M

### 2. Direct Group
Sells auto, renters, and personal umbrella policies directly to consumers via digital and phone channels.
- **GWP (YTD):** $507.5M | **Net Income:** $44.8M

### 3. Home Insurance Group
Specializes in homeowners, condo, and flood insurance products with deep underwriting expertise.
- **GWP (YTD):** $451.0M | **Net Income:** $46.0M

4. Coverage Determination

6. Settlement Negotiation

   ↓

## 🔒 Security & Incident Response

> Security procedures and what to do in case of incidents.

### Phishing & Social Engineering Response

| Step | Action |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Do NOT click** any links or download attachments |
| 2 | **Do NOT reply** to the suspicious message |
| 3 | Report via the **"Report Phishing" button** in Outlook |
| 4 | Forward suspicious email to **security@rockinsurance.com** |
| 5 | If you clicked a link — **immediately** contact IT Help Desk (ext. 5000) |
| 6 | Change your password via [Password Reset Portal](#) |
